title: ForceRaidHard
description: Force raid to be in hard mode even if you do not play on hard.
body:
This plugin make the [mobs spawn in raids](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Raid#Raid_wave_composition) to be hard mode.

This is so you can get totem from raid if you like to play in easy mode as Evoker does not spawn in raid if you play on easy.

This plugin does not work on spigot as I use paper only api.
